experiments.scope: H1, H1-P1, H5' (proof.md Sections 3, 4, 6). Trials 0..7 run the counted P1 claw on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform 256-bit words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 38-step compression gives the chaining value) at a reduced table size ls = 17 with 2^13 values of u (the full-scale procedure uses ls = 26 and 2^28; sized to the organizer budget of 256 trials in 20 s, as our accepted entries size theirs); trials 8..255 return no pair by design. The program builds the direct-mapped table over a0 in window R = 9, scans 2^lu values of u, and for every claw found: compares the set of claws against an independent sorted-array search over the same stored table and u stream (claws_equal_ref), rebuilds the real E16 of the P1 pair (both free words a0 and a1) and checks it lies in the 160-word row-16 set (claw_e16_in_S160), and runs the counted post-filter chain C1, C2, G, F7, reporting the stage counts. It returns M0||M1 and M0||M1' (128 bytes each) only if a claw passes all four filters (none is expected at the reduced size). This tests the counted program, claw completeness and the memory-free post-filter chain; it does not test q3.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 by design (no good pair is expected at the reduced table size). Mismatches: claws_equal_ref = 1 and claw_e16_bad = 0 on every trial. Observations: occ_frac (about 0.632), claws, ref_claws, claws_equal_ref, expected_claws, c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, good_pairs, claw_e16_bad, claw_e16_in_S160, counted_ops. A local emulation of the 256-trial request ran in 4.8 s: on every working trial the claws equal the reference and every claw is verified as a row-16 pass of the real P1 pair (0 bad). The occupancy, the claw count against 160 x occ x 2^ls / 2^32 per u and the stage rates match their exact expectations.

experiments.scope: H2-P1 and H1-P1 (proof.md Sections 6, 7). Trials 0..7 collect the claws (each a row-16 pass of a P1 pair by construction) of the counted procedure on a seed-drawn first block at ls = 17 with 2^14 values of u (trials 8..255 return no pair by design; local emulation of the request 3.0 s), rebuild both members of every row-16 pass and report how many follow the P8 cells at rows 17, 18, 19, 20, 21 cumulatively (the structural lemma: rows 17..21 read only S's words and W16..W21, so they hold for every good pair), together with the post-filter stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4 whose per-claw rates are the exact enumeration of proof.md Section 6. No full collision is returned by design: q3 is about 2^-96, far below any sandbox sample, so the pooled success rate at this scale is the product of the measured stage rates.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. Observations: claws, row16_passes, rows_le17, rows_le18, rows_le19, rows_le20, rows_le21, c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, q3_model_log2. At the reduced size no claw reaches a good pair (rows_le17 = 0) because row 17 encodes the W7, W8, W9 difference conditions C1, C2, G, F7; a run at the organizer's larger ls and lu makes them positive and every good pair found follows rows 17..21 (structural lemma). The post-filter stage counts match the exact rates P(C1) = 1/8, P(C1 and C2) = 2^-6.3379, P(G | C1,C2, R=9) = 2^-5.9478, P(F7) = 2^-3.9020.
